name: Precision Metalworks LLC
old_description: Founded with a passion for turning ideas into reality, Precision Metalworks began as a part-time endeavor in 2019, driven by a love for craftsmanship and the art of creating unique welding projects. What started as a small-scale venture has since evolved into the creation of remarkable structural masterpieces, proudly serving some of the most renowned food processing plants.
about:
Precision Metalworks LLC operates from a shop on Dunbar Street in Fremont, Nebraska. The business was founded in 2019 as a part-time welding venture by a single craftsman working after hours, building a reputation one job at a time. What began with one machine and mobile repairs has grown into a full-time fabrication and welding operation serving eastern Nebraska.

The company provides three core services: mobile welding that brings equipment to farms and plants, repair welding for cracked or worn components, and custom fabrication from prints or rough sketches. In-house capabilities include a MultiCam 3000 waterjet with KMT pump, an Amada shear, an Amada press brake, Syncrowave AC/DC TIG welders, and MIG welding for production steel work. The shop works in stainless steel, aluminum, and mild steel ranging from 22-gauge sheet to structural plate, handling everything from sanitary food-grade vessels to heavy equipment buckets and trailer frames.

Customers span food processing plants that require sanitary stainless welds, agricultural operations needing field repairs on combines and tillage tools, trailer owners with hitch and gooseneck damage, and industrial shops requiring brackets, racks, guards, and one-off structural parts. The mobile unit travels daily across eastern Nebraska, covering communities from Omaha to Schuyler.

The founder's intent was to keep work in-house rather than subcontract cutting and forming, shortening lead times and keeping a single point of accountability. The same tolerances demanded by food plants are applied to every trailer hitch and bracket, delivered at small-shop pricing with direct phone access.
